dishes.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, bake just before serving

steps.text: Wilt the spinach in a dry pan, cool, then squeeze very dry and chop with the artichokes.
Mix the spinach and artichokes with the cream cheese, sour cream, most of the mozzarella, the parmesan and the garlic.
Spoon into a small baking dish, top with the rest of the mozzarella and bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling.
Serve hot with the corn chips for scooping.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, a pinch of salt and a drop of green food colouring until smooth.
Pipe back into the whites and scatter the chives on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Crush the biscuits up to 3 days ahead, airtight; melt the chocolate and toast the marshmallows on the night

steps.text: Melt the dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water and crush the digestive biscuits in a bag with a rolling pin.
Push 2 marshmallows onto each bamboo skewer.
Toast over a gas flame or under a hot grill, turning often, until the outside blisters.
Dip in the melted chocolate, then in the crushed biscuits, and eat while warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork and beef mince with the egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper and roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes.
Simmer the passata with the oregano, add the meatballs and simmer for 15 minutes.
Split the long rolls, pack in the meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top.
Grill for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese has melted.

veg.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the chopped mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until dry and browned, then cool.
Mash the lentils roughly, then mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper and roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs on a lined tray at 200C for 20 minutes until firm.
Simmer the passata with the oregano, add the meatballs and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Split the long rolls, pack in the meatballs and sauce, lay the provolone on top and grill for 2 to 3 minutes until melted.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead and chill

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before, spread it on a tray and chill overnight.
Slice the lap cheong and spring onions and beat the eggs.
Heat a wok until smoking with half the oil, scramble the eggs, then add the lap cheong, rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot. Stir through the spring onions.
Fry the frozen pork dumplings in the rest of the oil in a frying pan for 2 minutes until the bases brown, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Serve out of takeaway boxes with the rest of the soy sauce on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead and chill

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before, spread it on a tray and chill overnight.
Dice the smoked tofu, slice the spring onions and beat the eggs.

Heat a wok until smoking with half the oil and fry the tofu for 2 minutes. Push it aside, scramble the eggs, then add the rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot. Stir through the spring onions.
Fry the frozen vegetable dumplings in the rest of the oil in a frying pan for 2 minutes until the bases brown, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Serve out of takeaway boxes with the rest of the soy sauce on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Best toasted and eaten straight away; nothing to make ahead

steps.text: Lay 8 digestive biscuits on a tray and put a square of milk chocolate on each.
Toast the marshmallows over a flame until golden and melting, or sit one on each chocolate square and put the tray under a hot grill for 30 seconds.
Press the remaining biscuits on top and eat straight away.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blitzed just before serving; chill the lemonade and lime cordial up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Blitz the ice with the lime cordial and lemonade until slushy.
Add a drop of green food colouring and blitz again.
Pour into 4 glasses and add a slice of lime to each.
